proposal.name: Publish large proposals with linked evidence

issue_plan.name: Publish large proposals with linked evidence
issue_plan.summary: These three plumbing changes make checked proposals and modeled questions publish even when their evidence will not fit in a GitHub comment. First add recoverable references to complete saved drafts, then serve those drafts through the dashboard, then publish compact comments that keep the exact statements, bounds, check results, commands and chart while linking to the full evidence. Drafts that fit keep their existing publication, and statement hashes, locks and model checks keep their meaning. Each step updates the current documentation; the merger records the new storage and publication decisions, including the refinement of the existing oversized-publication refusal policy.

issues.title: Recover complete modeled drafts through saved-record references
issues.body:
Issue #783 follows checked drafts on ask3d that failed only because their reader evidence and captured baselines exceeded GitHub's comment limit or the marker's 4 MiB expanded limit. Add the storage and recovery support for carrying a small reference in a factory marker while the complete checked modeled draft remains in its durable run record. This is one plumbing change: add and exercise the reference format and all factory consumers, without switching ordinary draft publication to the size fallback yet.

The factory already saves a formalize.Result as result.json in a Git commit before finishing refs/invariant/runs/<issue>/<step>. Build on that durable record, not local watcher work directories, expiring CI artifacts, branch-tip files, or a dashboard cache. A versioned reference must identify its repository, issue, draft step, immutable result commit and SHA-256 of the complete saved payload. The reference is transport identity, separate from the proposal hash. It must locate the exact checked proposal, model, includes, view, bounds, statement pins, complete reader and comparison, all option snapshots and receipts, report, changes and caller-owned check context. Keep publication metadata such as an issue-selected project directory and agent consistent with what recovery will load: save the effective payload before exposing its reference, rather than silently reconstructing different authority after a restart. Existing completed-run records and inline markers must remain readable.

Provide shared decoding and validation of references and loaded result bytes so factory and dashboard readers can use the same contract. Only a marker accepted under the existing factory-author rules can establish a reference; resolving it must match the enclosing repository and issue, the recorded completed draft step and pinned commit, payload digest and expected proposal identity. Refuse malformed or unsupported references, moving refs in place of commit IDs, unrelated runs, incomplete results, conflicting inline and referenced contents, truncated or substituted payloads, and invalid reader, preview or comparison evidence. Reads are confined to the saved result path in the stated repository and commit. This adds no authority to caller-supplied URLs or paths, and does not raise or remove the existing 4 MiB marker decompression limit. Do not impose that inline-marker limit on the externally stored complete payload.

Resolve a referenced proposal before the factory uses it for protocol observations, choices, revisions, ratification or building. Preserve the reference when later posts carry that proposal, including partial-choice, ratified, stopped and failed posts, so the next post does not put the oversized payload back into its marker. Keep the original checked preview contexts intact while the current marker records which forks remain and which answers a person actually gave. A final answer carries the captured baseline forward without becoming a revision; a revision receives the complete selected previous proposal and original amendment target. Ratification must still commit exactly the pinned statements and bounds that the person named. A failed reference read must neither fall back to an earlier proposal nor consume a pending command, rerun a completed drafting agent, start a build, or publish a truncated usable proposal; leave an actionable diagnostic and make a later successful read retryable. Preserve the existing lease, run and refused-effect rules without changing the proved protocol or recovery cores.

Read and reuse the real Git-backed test rig and existing behavioral checks in internal/factory/factory_test.go, runs_test.go, post_test.go, recovery_test.go, reader_603_accept_test.go, preview_639_accept_test.go, comparison_648_accept_test.go, planning_preview_recovery_regression_test.go and failed_preview_capacity_regression_test.go. Before ratifying this issue's implementation plan, include any existing test file whose fixture or expectation actually needs changing. Add regressions for reference round trips with payloads over 4 MiB, a fresh watcher and clone, completed-run recovery without another agent call, partial choices across restart, revision baseline retention, exact ratification, carried posts staying decodable, unavailable and corrupt records, copied references from another issue or repository, and a non-factory comment containing a reference. Keep the hostile compressed-marker and legacy-inline tests. Test saved bytes and actual factory actions, not only a reference struct's fields.

Update SPEC.md and docs/statecharts.md and the relevant factory recovery documentation to describe the new optional reference representation and its validation while preserving the current publication policy at this step. Changed SPEC bullets cite the decisions they rest on. This rests on D-0036's durable issue state, D-0069's completed-run recovery, D-0034's ratification identity, D-0345's checked proposal evidence, D-0355's complete alternative snapshots, D-0362's captured baselines, and D-0387's storage rules. The reference representation is a new refinement that the merger must record; this plumbing build cannot write decisions/. D-0105 makes this tested plumbing, and D-0122 and D-0294 require current documentation.

Kind: plumbing

issues.title: Serve saved draft evidence from the dashboard
issues.body:
Issue #783 requires full evidence for an oversized modeled proposal or question to remain readable outside its GitHub comment. The preceding change added versioned factory references to complete checked result.json records in completed draft runs, with repository, issue, step, immutable commit and payload digest validation. Add dashboard loading, evidence pages and links for that representation in one plumbing pull request. Publication can still use its existing size policy during this change; exercise the new reader using genuine referenced-marker fixtures.

Load referenced records through the repository's existing GitHub reads at the pinned result commit, using the shared reference validator. Only the known factory account's marker for that configured repository and issue establishes source authority, as with current preview and comparison pages. A URL, a short proposal hash, a copied marker from another author, a local run directory, or newer branch contents cannot establish authority. An unrecognized repository or arbitrary commit must not turn the dashboard into a general Git file server. Support complete records larger than the marker's 4 MiB expanded limit and preserve every source byte, transition occurrence, hidden step, baseline, option snapshot, diagnostic and tool provenance in the retained record.

Define a deterministic public saved-draft locator containing repository, issue, immutable result commit and full payload digest, which a watcher can construct without contacting the dashboard. It resolves only an authenticated saved-draft reference and redirects to a script-free evidence page whose immutable identity binds both the validated record and current rendered contents. Serve the complete validated saved record as downloadable JSON as well as readable text, and retain the existing native SVG and animated/still poster presentation. A proposal page shows exact candidate rules and bounds, what TLC checked, source and tool identities, and any complete captured comparison and its qualifications. A question page presents all alternatives together, with exact question and option wording, candidate statements, bounds, checks, prior-choice context and each option's complete evidence page; it also retains the captured baseline the next draft uses. Label alternatives unratified and model-only, and never add a ratification action or code-assurance claim to them. A too_large result retains its checked state count and explanation rather than acquiring a fabricated chart.

Carry the reference and the full validated proposal into the dashboard's existing waiting-state and presentation path. The Needs you card on both the public page and /act links to the same saved draft evidence, alongside its existing proposal or option presentations; choosing or ratifying continues to use the existing authorized command path and original hash. Keep the visible remaining forks and current answers separate from the original complete snapshots after partial choices. Missing, invalid or temporarily unreadable evidence gets a visible diagnostic and no usable ratification or choice controls based on an unresolved payload. It must not be mistaken for a legacy chart-free proposal. A later successful read recovers even if the issue's comment timestamp did not change. Healthy siblings and unrelated issues continue to serve.

Use the existing proposal/preview cache lifecycle for validation, native rendering and atomic persistence rather than creating a parallel unvalidated rendering path. Validate saved records again on restart against their reference, repository and factory identity. Keep published locator links usable after a revision, answer or ratification removes the current Needs you card: retain their source authority and either serve retained validated evidence or reload the same immutable run, never redirect to the latest proposal. Presentation-cache eviction may still reclaim generated pages that can be reconstructed from that exact retained record. A failed read, save or snapshot replacement must preserve already-published healthy evidence; a damaged cache must not silently reseal altered bytes as the original. GET and bodyless HEAD work, unsupported methods are refused, missing or invalid evidence returns an explicit non-success response, and immutable responses use representation-bound ETags and the existing script-free security headers.

Inspect internal/dashboard/dashboard.go, issues.go, http.go, comparisons.go, previews.go, proposal_cache.go and the public and /act card rendering before choosing the implementation file scope. Reuse and preserve the author, presentation and restart checks in preview_639_accept_test.go, proposal_cache_730_accept_test.go, proposal_cache_retention_730_accept_test.go, proposal_publication_regression_test.go, proposal_poster_784_test.go, preview_cache_regression_test.go and the reader recovery tests. The GitHub fixture in reader_631_accept_test.go validates direct GET invocation and exact contents endpoints at immutable refs; extend or add a fixture for saved run refs and result.json rather than relaxing its request checks. Name every existing test that needs modification in this issue's implementation plan. Add tests from a compact factory marker through real dashboard loading to the state JSON, both cards, HTML/JSON/SVG responses and restart. Cover a large ordinary proposal, all alternatives and baseline of a large question, comparisons, exact JSON retrieval, hostile literal text, author/repository/issue/commit/digest substitution, missing records followed by recovery, failed persistence, old-link retrieval after replacement and cache damage.

Update SPEC.md, docs/dashboard.md and docs/statecharts.md for the delivered routes, complete evidence, trust and retention behavior; use docs/factory.md for any shared reference details that need linking. Keep the README front page within its existing budget and change it only if its current claims become false. Cite D-0049, D-0353, D-0355, D-0362, D-0368, D-0394 and D-0414 for dashboard source validation, option isolation, cache behavior and poster presentation, together with the saved-reference decision recorded for the preceding change. The durable locator and record-retention policy is a new refinement for the merger to record under D-0122; the build cannot edit decisions/. This is D-0105 plumbing and its documentation follows D-0294.

Kind: plumbing

issues.title: Publish compact comments when modeled evidence exceeds comment limits
issues.body:
Complete issue #783 by using the saved-draft references and dashboard evidence locator now available on the base branch. On 2026-11-09, ask3d#11 and ask3d#16 could not publish questions containing their option previews and baselines; another ask3d#16 draft failed with only 8 chart states and 41 arrows because transition evidence was 135 KB and reader.json was 248 KB. These are publication failures, not model failures. Make a valid modeled proposal, revision, amendment or question publish with a compact comment whenever its ordinary complete comment or expanded marker does not fit. This is one tested plumbing change, not an amendment of a proved state machine.

First attempt the current publication unchanged. If the complete comment is within the existing maxComment budget and its marker reads back under the existing maxMarker limit, preserve its text, inline evidence, marker and commands. Otherwise use the complete checked saved record and the small reference format, and render a compact comment. The marker must stay under its existing expanded limit and the entire posted comment, including marker, byline, commands and links, must fit maxComment. Do not increase GitHub or decompression limits, shrink checking bounds, drop alternatives, rerun the drafting agent to reduce evidence, or erase reader evidence from the authoritative saved draft. Never mutate the original reader, preview, comparison or hash to make a display fit. Persist and finish the exact referenced record before posting any actionable comment; a transient publication failure or restart reuses it without another agent run.

A compact proposal or amendment keeps every candidate statement's exact wording, kind and relevant known-bug expectation, the exact checked bounds, the existing account of what TLC checked, prior decisions and the original ratify and revise commands. Retain amendment warnings for removed or changed invariants, properties and fairness, old and new wording where it changed, and checking-scope changes; unchanged candidate statements must also be readable in the compact comment. A compact modeled question keeps every remaining question and option verbatim, each option's candidate statements, exact bounds and TLC check summary, its unratified/model-only qualification, prior authorized choices and the choose/revise instructions. Choosing an option still ratifies nothing and starts no build. Comparison comments name the captured baseline and both scopes and retain the material view/model/scope qualifications.

Draw each supported checked chart with every state, initial and labeled directed arrow, using literal-safe Mermaid and generated aliases as the current renderer does, but omit per-arrow and per-occurrence evidence tables from the compact display. Keep comparison additions/removals and their legend interpretable while moving the full comparison evidence to the linked page. Keep concise counts and clearly say that the complete evidence, hidden steps and provenance are available at the link. Do not cut the chart to an advisory arrow target. Models over the existing 500-state chart capacity keep their faithful limitation note, bounds and checks. Full saved JSON and dashboard evidence continue to contain all visible and hidden occurrences, sources, previews and baselines. Each compact comment links to the exact saved-draft locator; the public and /act Needs you cards already expose that record through the preceding dashboard change.

Wire an explicit public dashboard base URL through the watcher to the comment link builder, with a documented -dashboard-url flag defaulting to the existing https://invariant.puglisij.com deployment. Validate an absolute HTTP(S) base without credentials, query or fragment before starting work, support a deployment path prefix, and document that other installations must set their own dashboard address and serve the repository there. Link generation must be deterministic and URL-escape path components; it must not make network calls or need a running dashboard during drafting. Dashboard availability is not model-check authority.

Use the same size fallback for newly completed and recovered drafts and for the remaining-options post after partial choices. Later ratified, failed or resumed posts must keep the compact reference and recover the full selected proposal. An unresolved or corrupt reference remains a diagnostic rather than a usable truncated proposal. Invalid, missing, swapped or stale previews and comparisons still refuse publication. If the indispensable decision text or chart itself cannot fit even after evidence is externalized, retain an explicit non-actionable size refusal with the full record saved; do not clip promises, split alternatives across independently actionable comments or emit a ratify/choose command for incomplete content. That exceptional case is distinct from the evidence-only overflow this issue fixes. Plumbing plans, plans of issues, legacy inline posts and chart-free questions keep their existing behavior.

Inspect internal/factory/factory.go's initial and partial-choice size checks, comments.go, statechart.go and thread.go; internal/statechart/markdown.go and comparison.go; and cmd/invariant/main.go's watcher flags and setup. Reuse the existing Go test rigs and fake verifier commands, retaining their validated flags and outputs. Test an evidence-heavy small-topology chart resembling the 8-state/41-arrow failure, incompressible data that exceeds the compressed-comment budget, a highly compressible complete record larger than 4 MiB, and a question with multiple forks, previews and a captured baseline. For each, assert successful single publication under the limits, full exact mandatory text and chart topology, working evidence links, complete saved bytes, and unchanged proposal/lock hashes. Cover recovery without redrafting, partial choice across a fresh watcher, final choice, revision and amendment baselines, exact ratification and the subsequent build handoff. Also cover invalid evidence, a mandatory statement or chart label too large to fit, no partial usable post on save failure, and byte-for-byte compatibility for a small draft. Exercise the actual watcher flag and resulting link, including a custom path prefix and invalid bases. Add a cross-package test that follows a factory-produced compact comment's link through the dashboard and compares the full returned saved record.

The old size-only refusal in internal/factory/marker_capacity_603_regression_test.go's TestModeledPublicationChecksExpandedMarker intentionally changes for valid externally saved evidence: name that existing test file in this issue's implementation plan and update its oversized expectation. Inspect reader_603_accept_test.go's TestReader603CommentCapacity and preview_639_accept_test.go's TestPreview639PublicationRejectsStaleAndOversized carefully: their huge reader label and huge exact statement respectively can still exceed the indispensable compact display, so retain their refusal unless the complete required display actually fits. Preserve post_test.go's hostile-marker limit and failed_preview_capacity_regression_test.go's failed-check behavior. Review comparison_648_accept_test.go, svg_parity_608_accept_test.go, closing_commands_accept_test.go and the watcher CLI tests for any pinned output intentionally affected, naming every existing test file the implementation must change. Tests must distinguish evidence overflow from oversized required wording instead of weakening either contract.

Update SPEC.md's blanket oversized-proposal and preview refusal descriptions and its self-contained-marker claims, plus docs/statecharts.md's proposal, alternative and comparison publication sections, docs/dashboard.md's saved evidence description and docs/factory.md's publication and watcher configuration details. Fix any README claim that becomes false in the same change, keeping detail on those linked pages and the front page at most 400 lines. New or changed SPEC bullets cite the recorded decisions they rest on. The merger must record this issue's new compact-publication decision refining D-0345, D-0355, D-0362 and D-0387; those decisions currently require complete inline publication or refusal and must no longer be described as the final policy. Preserve D-0034's statement/bounds ratification identity, D-0045's amendment warnings, D-0069's recovery, D-0343's chart bounds, and D-0353/D-0394's evidence validation; D-0105, D-0122 and D-0294 govern the plumbing and docs. Decision recording is merger work because the build cannot write decisions/. Existing CI integration and affected real-tool suites remain required checks, with no CI policy changes or unplanned follow-up.

Kind: plumbing
